Currently
column2: pointer offsets in three BPF context structures are

column1: broken in two scenarios: i) 32 bit compiled applications running
on 64 bit kernels
column2: and ii) LLVM compiled BPF programs running

column1: on 32 bit kernels. The latter is due to BPF target machine being
strictly 64 bit. So in each of the cases the offsets will mismatch
in verifier when checking / rewriting context access. Fix this by
providing a helper macro __bpf_md_ptr() that will enforce padding
up to 64 bit and proper alignment
column2: and for context access a macro

column1: bpf_ctx_range_ptr() which will cover full 64 bit member range on
32 bit archs. For flow_keys
column2: we additionally need to force the

column1: size check to sizeof(__u64) as with other pointer types.
